records.question: Does Kolmogorov–Loveland randomness coincide with Martin-Löf randomness?
records.status_statement: SRC-0018's publisher abstract calls whether Martin-Löf randomness is the same as KL-randomness one of the major open problems in effective randomness.
records.later_status_note: SRC-0019's 2025 publisher abstract explicitly still calls KLR=MLR a major open problem.
records.current_status_note: SOURCE-STATED OPEN on the documented 2025 evidence. P1-S001 did not find and does not claim an exhaustive post-2025 resolution search.

records.question: Does any implication in Martin-Löf random -> endomorphism random -> automorphism random -> Kolmogorov-Loveland random reverse?
records.status_statement: SRC-0060 Question 10.8 asks whether any implication in (10.1) reverses; its footnote 11 reports Petrovic's claim (SRC-0071) that would make endomorphism randomness equal to MLR.
records.later_status_note: No later status check was made in P4-S083; SRC-0071 and SRC-0019 bear on the first implication only as recorded.
records.current_status_note: Recorded at source-stated level only; no openness inference is drawn by the programme.
